sources.entry: 17. YouCam Makeup - Makeup and beauty editor.

summary.name: YouCam Makeup
summary.one_liner: YouCam Makeup is a selfie makeup and face editing app offering virtual makeup try-ons, face shaping, and skin smoothing, with an optional Premium subscription.
use_cases: try on lipstick, blush and eyeliner virtually before buying makeup
apply realistic makeup looks to a photo
edit photos and videos for social content
summary.what_it_does: The app provides hundreds of makeup looks and real-time virtual try-ons for lipsticks, blushes, and eyeliners. It includes face-shaping tools and skin-smoothing tools for photo retouching. Free users can access these everyday beauty filters and retouching features without subscribing. An optional Premium subscription unlocks unlimited access to advanced editing features aimed at creators and beauty enthusiasts. The page's listing describes it as a makeup and beauty editor, and the page also mentions photo and video editing tools.
notable: Hundreds of realistic makeup looks with real-time virtual try-on
Core features free without forced subscription
caveats: Advanced editing features require the optional Premium subscription
Mobile apps only per the page text (iOS and Android)
